releaseName: OFMtouch v0.6.5 — Finance & Club Identity · Build 349
notes:
# OFMtouch v0.6.5 — Finance & Club Identity

- Correct Premier League home colours and kit patterns, including Manchester City's sky blue.
- Rebalanced fictional player values: regular squad players in the tens of millions, with exceptional stars worth more.
- Correct annual salary generation, larger working balances and transfer budgets, and wage headroom at career start.
- Recurring commercial and media income alongside fixed operating costs, visible in cash flow and forecasts.
- One-time financial repair for existing standard careers, preserving contracts, past spending, match results and saves.
- New financial data persists through saves; previous patch notes remain available.

Budgets are game estimates informed by published accounts. Annual revenue is distinct from cash and transfer spending. See `docs/ECONOMY-0.6.5.md` for sources and model limits.

Thank you for playing and helping improve OFMtouch by reporting issues.

Thanks, TranquilMT

Android ARM64. Install over your existing OFMtouch app to keep your saves. The package name and persistent signing certificate are unchanged. Full matching source and SHA-256 checksums are included.
